description: Submit an event for review. Goes to the moderation queue. Browser forms pass Turnstile; programmatic callers send an API key instead. A signed-in caller (session or user-scope key) skips Turnstile, is recorded as the submitter, may omit organizer_email (the account email is used), and a trusted submitter's event can publish straight away when auto-approval is on. Anonymous callers must send organizer_email.

city.description: The town; required unless location_kind is online

hosted_by.description: The group or shop hosting an online or hybrid event

languages.description: The languages the event is held in, as BCP 47 codes (en, es); leave out when unknown

state.description: A US state name or two-letter code; required unless location_kind is online (then taken from the time zone)

timezone.description: The event's own clock (IANA, like America/Chicago); required for an online or hybrid event

name: submit_event
title: Submit an event for review
